cards.text: Ezekiel, a prophet, says the word of the LORD came to him again. God tells him to take a single stick and write on it. And friend, writing on wood? That's my WHOLE job description.

cards.question: God has Ezekiel write a name on that first stick, along with the Israelites associated with him. Which tribe's name is it?

cards.text: Then a second stick, labeled for Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and all the house of Israel associated with him. Two sticks, two labels, and Ezekiel standing there like he's running a garage sale.

cards.question: God tells Ezekiel to keep the Judah stick and the Joseph stick apart, one in each hand.

cards.text: So Ezekiel's holding two sticks joined into one, and God says the people are going to ask what he means by these. Of course they are. If somebody stood out front doing that, I'd have my whole face pressed on the window.

cards.question: When the people ask about the two sticks, Ezekiel is told to answer with his own ideas.
God explains the sticks. He will put the stick of Joseph together with the stick of Judah, and they will become one in His ___.

cards.text: With the sticks held up where everybody can see them, God says what this is really about. He will take the Israelites out of the nations they've gone to and gather them from all around.

cards.question: God is gathering the Israelites from all around. Where does He say He'll bring them?

cards.text: God says He will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. Friend, the sticks were the trailer. THIS is the movie.

cards.question: Now that they're one nation, God says ___ king will rule over all of them.
God says His people could split into two kingdoms again someday.

cards.text: Then God says they won't defile themselves with idols or detestable images anymore. He will save them from all their apostasies and cleanse them, and friend, after years under junk drawer dust, CLEAN is my favorite word.

cards.question: Once God cleanses His people, what does He say comes next?

answers.text: They will be His people and He will be their God
They will rule over all the nations around them
They will never face another enemy again

cards.text: God calls the coming king My servant and says there will be one shepherd for all of them. ONE shepherd, friend, not a group chat with forty people hitting reply all.

cards.question: God calls the coming king His servant and one shepherd for all of them. What name does He give him?

cards.text: They'll live in the land God gave His servant Jacob, where their fathers lived, with their children and grandchildren, forever. I shared a drawer with an expired coupon that never stopped believing, and friend, THIS promise doesn't expire.

cards.question: God makes a covenant of peace with His people, and He says it will be an ___ covenant.

cards.text: God says He'll establish them, multiply them and set His sanctuary among them forever. His dwelling place will be with them, and that promise comes back: He will be their God, and they will be His people.

cards.question: When God's sanctuary is among His people forever, who does He say will know that the LORD sanctifies Israel?

findings.problem: The joke 'writing on wood? That's my WHOLE job description' doesn't work. Papa Dorin is a cookie stamper who presses dough. He doesn't write on wood (the Millers carved his handle). The comparison doesn't match the core action, and it adds a new fact about his world.

rule.text: It clicks instantly for any adult, with no explaining.

findings.problem: This story card has three sentences: 'So Ezekiel's holding...', 'Of course they are.' and 'If somebody stood out front...'.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: This story card has three sentences: 'God says He will make them one nation...', 'Friend, the sticks were the trailer.' and 'THIS is the movie.'

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The wrong answers 'two' and 'twelve' don't fit the blank grammatically ('two king will rule', 'twelve king will rule'). Only 'one' reads correctly, so the right answer stands out.

rule.text: Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike.

findings.problem: Both wrong answers start with 'Only' ('Only the priests', 'Only the prophets'), and the right answer 'The nations' doesn't. That pattern singles out the right answer.

rule.text: Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike.

findings.problem: No card tells the rest of Ezekiel 37:24: 'They will follow My ordinances and keep and observe My statutes.' This promise that the people will obey is an important detail of the passage.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.

findings.problem: The card tells Ezekiel 37:25 but leaves out 'My servant David will be their prince forever.' No other card covers it, so the baker never hears that David's rule is forever.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.
